summary: This 8-K reports the start of separate trading of Class A ordinary shares and warrants from units issued in QDRO Acquisition Corp.'s IPO, effective May 20, 2026. No transaction, acquisition, or special situation is involved; it is a routine administrative event for a blank-check company. There are no deal terms, premiums, or board recommendations. The filing is a standard post-IPO unit separation notice, not a special situation.
